one_line: Remembered founder of the Western Ganga line that rose around Kolar and Talakad in southern Karnataka, c. 350–370 CE.

appearance.age_look: Early 40s, medium height, athletic but not bulky, with the steady bearing of a seasoned frontier ruler.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, full lips, medium-brown southern Indian complexion, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, sharp dark eyes set under slightly arched brows; default expression calm and resolute, with a hint of strategic focus.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair pulled back into a compact topknot at the crown, with the sides smoothed back; a narrow gold circlet resting just above the forehead, simple and undecorated except for a tiny central boss.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length off‑white cotton tunic (angarkha-style wrap, tied at the right side) with long sleeves and a modest V‑neck, over which falls a rich deep‑red silk uttariya drape from left shoulder across chest and back; a tightly wrapped golden‑yellow cotton dhoti with a broad maroon border is tied at the waist, pleats falling to the ankles, worn with simple brown leather sandals; a fitted dark‑green cloth kamarband (waist sash) secures the dhoti, and a narrow, finely worked gold necklace, small gold stud earrings, and two plain gold bangles on his right wrist add restrained royal ornament; no heavy armour, just a practical, era‑accurate frontier king’s attire in fine but functional textiles.
appearance.signature: A straight, single‑edged iron sword with a slightly broad blade, simple iron cross‑guard, and wooden hilt wrapped in dark leather, carried in a plain brown scabbard that hangs from his left hip on a dark‑green cloth belt.

ref_desc: Konganivarman Madhava is a medium-built, bearded southern Indian king with a black topknot and gold circlet, wearing an off-white tunic, deep-red silk shoulder drape, golden-yellow bordered dhoti, dark-green sash, modest gold jewellery, and a plain iron sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw Konganivarman Madhava as a full-body shonen-anime style character: a medium-built, early-40s southern Indian ruler with an oval face, medium-brown skin, sharp dark eyes, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, his thick black hair tied into a compact topknot under a simple narrow gold circlet. Show him in an era-accurate 4th-century southern Karnataka outfit: a knee-length off-white cotton wrap tunic with long sleeves and modest V-neck, a rich deep-red silk uttariya draped from his left shoulder across his chest and back, a tightly wrapped golden-yellow cotton dhoti with a broad maroon border falling to his ankles, and a fitted dark-green cloth sash at the waist. Add small gold stud earrings, a narrow gold necklace, and two plain gold bangles on his right wrist, with simple brown leather sandals on his feet. At his left hip, hang a straight, single-edged iron sword in a plain brown scabbard on a dark-green cloth belt. Use deep red, golden yellow, off-white, dark green, and medium brown as the dominant colours, and pose him standing calmly and resolutely, ready to rule a frontier region between rival powers.
